verdict: Instagram lead ads delivered 109 leads this period, but cost per lead sits well above healthy furnace benchmarks.
diagnosis: You spent $12,512 for 109 leads — roughly $115 each — just as heating demand enters its December peak window.

signals.headline: 109 leads at $115 each
signals.detail: Instagram furnace form generated real volume, but cost per lead runs above the $30–$90 healthy range for HVAC.

signals.headline: 295 reviews averaging 5 stars
signals.detail: Google Business Profile is a trust asset. Reviews like Brian James's convert cold shoppers better than any ad creative.

signals.headline: 93 call clicks, 235 direction requests
signals.detail: Google profile drove more booked-intent actions than paid clicks did. Local search is punching above its weight.

signals.headline: 1,482 link clicks, zero tracked purchases
signals.detail: No purchase conversions firing from the pixel. You cannot see which leads become jobs right now.

signals.headline: Follower base grew by 20
signals.detail: Organic Instagram added 20 followers and 6,673 reached accounts. Small but free compounding audience for winter.

benchmark.label: BENCHMARK
benchmark.body: Industry data puts HVAC lead costs at $30–$90 on high-intent channels, with blended Google Ads around $104 and non-branded search near $149. Your $115 sits mid-pack but has room to improve.

seasonal.label: SEASONAL
seasonal.body: Furnace repair searches spike up to 594% from August through December. November is pre-peak — the right moment to shift budget toward high-intent heating keywords before January.

competitor.label: COMPETITOR
competitor.body: Google Local Services Ads average $51 per HVAC lead with a 44% booking rate. Seven in ten contractors now use them, pushing costs up but still beating social lead forms.

recommendations.title: Test Google Local Services Ads for heating calls
recommendations.detail: Local Services Ads averaged $51 per HVAC lead this year. Worth exploring a small test budget before December peak to compare against your $115 Instagram leads.

recommendations.title: Tighten the Instagram furnace form or pause it
recommendations.detail: Consider adding a qualifying question (home ownership, system age) to filter low-intent form fills. If cost per lead stays above $100, redirect that budget.

recommendations.title: Fix purchase tracking before December
recommendations.detail: Zero return on ad spend is a measurement problem, not a performance one. Test the Facebook pixel purchase event so you can see which leads become jobs.
